commit.message:
Add scripts/simulate to run the simulator with random seeds for a while

A small orchestrator after TigerBeetle's continuous fuzzing setup: one
worker per core runs the simulator with fresh random seeds, alternating
between lite and full configurations, until a time budget expires. Each
run is recorded as one JSON line with the commit, seed, mode, outcome,
duration, and the command to reproduce it. Logs are kept only for runs
that failed or exceeded the per-run timeout, and the failing commands
are listed at the end. Workers take a lock when appending results so
records never interleave.

+
+It alternates between lite and full runs, appends one JSON line per run to
+`target/simulate/results.jsonl`, keeps the log of every failed run under
+`target/simulate/logs/`, and prints the commands to reproduce the failures
+at the end. A run that exceeds `--timeout` (default 10 minutes) counts as a
+failure.
+
 ## References
 
 The implementation of `vsr-rs` is based on the paper [Viewstamped Replication Revisited](https://pmg.csail.mit.edu/papers/vr-revisited.pdf) by Liskov and Cowling.

@@ -0,0 +1,104 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+#
+# Runs the simulator with random seeds on every core until a time budget
+# expires. Each run is a fresh seed, alternating between --lite and full
+# swarm configurations. A run that exits non-zero or exceeds the timeout is
+# a failure; its log is kept and its seed is printed so it can be reproduced.
+#
+# Usage: scripts/simulate [--budget DURATION] [--timeout DURATION]
+#                         [--concurrency N] [--out DIR]
+#
+# Durations take the same suffixes as timeout(1): 30s, 10m, 2h.
+#
+# Results are appended as one JSON line per run to $OUT/results.jsonl, with
+# the commit, seed, mode, outcome, duration, and the command to reproduce.
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+budget=60m
+timeout_per_run=10m
+concurrency=$(nproc)
+out=target/simulate
+
+while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
+    case "$1" in
+        --budget) budget=$2; shift 2 ;;
+        --timeout) timeout_per_run=$2; shift 2 ;;
+        --concurrency) concurrency=$2; shift 2 ;;
+        --out) out=$2; shift 2 ;;
+        -h|--help) sed -n '2,15p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; exit 0 ;;
+        *) echo "unknown argument: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
+    esac
+done
+
+cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
+cargo build --release -p vsr-simulator
+mkdir -p "$out/logs"
+
+# Convert a timeout(1)-style duration to seconds.
+to_seconds() {
+    local d=$1
+    case "$d" in
+        *s) echo "${d%s}" ;;
+        *m) echo $(( ${d%m} * 60 )) ;;
+        *h) echo $(( ${d%h} * 3600 )) ;;
+        *) echo "$d" ;;
+    esac
+}
+
+commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
+if ! git diff --quiet HEAD; then
+    commit="$commit-dirty"
+fi
+deadline=$(( $(date +%s) + $(to_seconds "$budget") ))
+results=$out/results.jsonl
+bin=./target/release/vsr-simulator
+
+echo "simulating commit $commit with $concurrency workers for $budget (timeout $timeout_per_run per run)"
+echo "results: $results"
+
+worker() {
+    while [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$deadline" ]; do
+        local seed mode args log start end status ok
+        seed=$(od -An -N8 -tu8 /dev/urandom | tr -d ' ')
+        if [ $(( seed % 2 )) -eq 0 ]; then mode=lite; args="--lite"; else mode=full; args=""; fi
+        log=$out/logs/$seed.log
+        start=$(date +%s)
+        set +e
+        # shellcheck disable=SC2086
+        timeout "$timeout_per_run" "$bin" $args "$seed" > "$log" 2>&1
+        status=$?
+        set -e
+        end=$(date +%s)
+        case $status in
+            0) ok=true; rm -f "$log" ;;
+            124) ok=false; echo "TIMEOUT after $timeout_per_run: $bin $args $seed (log: $log)" >&2 ;;
+            *) ok=false; echo "FAILED (exit $status): $bin $args $seed (log: $log)" >&2 ;;
+        esac
+        # Workers append concurrently; take the lock so records never interleave.
+        (
+            flock 9
+            printf '{"commit":"%s","seed":%s,"mode":"%s","ok":%s,"exit":%d,"seconds":%d,"command":"%s"}\n' \
+                "$commit" "$seed" "$mode" "$ok" "$status" $(( end - start )) \
+                "cargo run --release -p vsr-simulator -- $args $seed" >&9
+        ) 9>>"$results"
+    done
+}
+
+pids=()
+trap 'kill "${pids[@]}" 2>/dev/null; wait; exit 130' INT TERM
+for _ in $(seq "$concurrency"); do
+    worker &
+    pids+=($!)
+done
+wait
+
+runs=$(grep -c "\"commit\":\"$commit\"" "$results" || true)
+failed=$(grep "\"commit\":\"$commit\"" "$results" | grep -c '"ok":false' || true)
+echo
+echo "commit $commit: $runs runs, $failed failed"
+if [ "$failed" -gt 0 ]; then
+    echo "reproduce with:"
+    grep "\"commit\":\"$commit\"" "$results" | grep '"ok":false' | sed 's/.*"command":"\([^"]*\)".*/  \1/'
+fi
+[ "$failed" -eq 0 ]
